Aug 2026 • Family
Had a really nice dinner at Mặn Mòi on Võ Văn Tần District 3. The food was flavorful and felt very Vietnamese, with the kind of seasoning that makes you want to keep eating even when you’re already full 😂

The dishes came out nicely presented and the portions were reasonable. I also really liked the atmosphere — cozy, casual, and comfortable enough for both a meal with friends or a family dinner.

The staff were friendly and attentive without being overbearing. Overall, a really enjoyable dining experience. If you’re around Võ Văn Tần and looking for Vietnamese food with bold, comforting flavors, Mặn Mòi is definitely worth trying!

An exceptional experience among authentic flavors and unforgettable hospitality
Jul 2026 • Couples
We were just there and I can say with absolute certainty that it was one of the best culinary experiences in Ho Chi Minh City! It deserves a full 5 stars from every point of view.
There is really nothing to say about the food other than that it is excellent: we tried typical dishes of a very high level, with careful presentation and rich in authentic flavors. I took so many photos to try to do justice to the quality of what we ate.
What makes this place even more special is the hospitality. I want to specifically mention Vinh Lý (whose name I also captured in a photo), our waiter, who was of rare kindness and professionalism, guiding us in our choices and ensuring that everything was perfect. As if that weren't enough, at the end of dinner they even surprised us with a very welcome gift: a handmade soap! A small gesture that demonstrates a truly unique care for the guest.
Another pleasant discovery was the shop on the lower floor. It is a truly well-kept corner where it is possible to find artisanal products, quality local teas, ceramics, and many other gems perfect as souvenirs or to take a little piece of Vietnam home with you. Obviously, I took photos there too!
In summary: well-kept location, stellar food, impeccable service, and a beautiful shop. A mandatory stop!

Authentic high -quality regional dishes with creative twists
May 2026 • Friends
Mặn Mòi in Ho Chi Minh City, a Bib Gourmand restaurant recognized by the Michelin Guide, serves authentic, high-quality Vietnamese cuisine in a lush, nature-inspired setting. Known for its stylish, popular atmosphere, it offers attentive service and creative takes on traditional, home-style regional dishes made with fresh ingredients, all within a vibrant, cozy environment.

The menu features a wide range of options, including soups, snacks, salads, main courses, fried rice, regional specialties, hot pots, and desserts. We enjoyed hearty, delicious dishes crafted from fresh ingredients, such as stir-fried Malabar spinach shoots, fried squid, stewed pork tail with lotus tubes, rambutan salad, and fried rice with Ca Mau eco-crab meat. Each dish was balanced, healthy, and tasted excellent.

After our visit, I understand why the Michelin Guide awards this Bib Gourmand restaurant. The food was excellent, with creative takes on traditional regional dishes, prepared in a comforting, home-style manner that is both satisfying and delicious. I definitely recommend trying it!
